direct.name: TXTImpact
direct.why: Sells email-to-SMS for businesses: an email to a number goes out as a text, with replies by email.

direct.name: Notifyre
direct.why: Has a named email-to-SMS gateway for US businesses that works from Gmail and Outlook.

direct.name: Textmagic
direct.why: Its email-to-SMS service sends a text when you email a number, and replies come back as email.

direct.name: ClickSend
direct.why: A messaging platform with a named email-to-SMS feature and replies forwarded to email.

partial.name: SimpleTexting
partial.why: An SMS marketing platform: it can text staff, but it is built for campaigns, not email alerts.

partial.name: Twilio
partial.why: A developer SMS API: it can do the same job, but only with code.
